A '''[[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]]''' served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] as a [[Jedi Commander/Legends|commander]] in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] at the [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]], becoming a good friend of fellow [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Initiate]] [[Ringoot]]. Summoned before the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] in [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], several months into the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the Initiate was dispatched to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dorin/Legends|Dorin]] where [[Kel Dor/Legends|Kel Dor]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] accepted the student as his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]].<ref name="DYD" />
